cases.sentence: Временная ___, балаган из досок, была построена подле самого гипподрома.
cases.translation: The temporary stable, a shed of boards, was built right beside the hippodrome.
cases.explain: «Конюшня» is the grammatical subject of «была построена», so it stands in the Nominative case.

cases.sentence: Едва он вышел из ___, как конюх его узнал его издалека.
cases.translation: He had barely gotten out of the carriage when his groom recognized him from afar.
cases.explain: The preposition «из» (out of) governs the Genitive case, hence «коляски».

cases.sentence: «Пожалуйста, не говорите громко», — прибавил он, кивая головой на запертый ___.
cases.translation: "Please don't speak loudly," he added, nodding toward the locked stall.
cases.explain: The preposition «на» with a direction/target of a nod takes the Accusative here, hence «денник».

cases.sentence: Вронский погладил ее крепкую шею и придвинулся лицом к ее ___.
cases.translation: Vronsky stroked her strong neck and brought his face close to her nostrils.
cases.explain: The preposition «к» (toward) governs the Dative case, hence «ноздрям».

cases.sentence: Он достал письмо матери и записку ___ и прочел их.
cases.translation: He took out his mother's letter and his brother's note and read them.
cases.explain: «Записка брата» (brother's note) expresses possession, requiring the Genitive «брата».

cases.translation: The horse's agitation communicated itself to Vronsky as well.
cases.explain: The verb «сообщилось» (was communicated to) governs the Dative case, hence «Вронскому».

cases.translation: He went up to Frou-Frou's stall.
cases.explain: «Фру-Фру» is an indeclinable foreign name, so its form stays the same in every case; here it functions as a Genitive of possession after «денник».

cases.sentence: Вронский погладил ее еще рукой по ___.
cases.translation: Vronsky stroked her once more with his hand on the rump.
cases.explain: The preposition «по» meaning "along/on" governs the Dative case, hence «заду».

cases.sentence: Кости ее ног ниже ___ казались не толще пальца.
cases.translation: The bones of her legs below the knee seemed no thicker than a finger.
cases.explain: The preposition «ниже» (below) governs the Genitive case, hence «колена».

cases.sentence: В деннике, перебирая ногами по свежей ___, стояла караковая лошадь с намордником.
cases.translation: In the stall, shifting her feet over fresh straw, stood a dark bay horse with a muzzle.
cases.explain: The preposition «по» with the Prepositional case (locative use here) governs «соломе».

cases.sentence: Ее вся, кроме ребер, как будто была сдавлена с ___.
cases.translation: Her whole body, except for the ribs, seemed compressed from the sides.
cases.explain: The preposition «с» meaning "from" governs the Genitive case, hence «боков».

reading.ru: Временная конюшня, балаган из досок, была построена подле самого гипподрома, и туда вчера должна была быть приведена его лошадь.
reading.question: Where had Vronsky's horse been brought the day before?
options: To a temporary stable near the hippodrome
reading.correct: To a temporary stable near the hippodrome
reading.explain: The text says the temporary stable was built right beside the hippodrome, and the horse was brought there the day before.

reading.ru: В эти последние дни он сам не ездил на проездку, а поручил тренеру, и теперь решительно не знал, в каком состоянии пришла и была его лошадь.
reading.question: Why didn't Vronsky know the horse's condition?
options: He had entrusted the exercising of the horse to the trainer
He was ill and couldn't travel
The horse had just been purchased
reading.correct: He had entrusted the exercising of the horse to the trainer
reading.explain: He had not gone to the exercising himself in recent days, entrusting it to the trainer instead.

reading.ru: Едва он вышел из коляски, как конюх его, грум, так называемый мальчик, узнав еще издалека его коляску, вызвал тренера.
reading.question: Who summoned the trainer when Vronsky arrived?
reading.correct: The groom (the "boy")
reading.explain: The groom recognized his carriage from a distance and called the trainer.

reading.ru: Сухой англичанин в высоких сапогах и в короткой жакетке, с клочком волос, оставленным только под подбородком, неумелую походкой жакеев, растопыривая локти и раскачиваясь, вышел навстречу.
reading.question: How is the English trainer described?
options: Lean, in tall boots and a short jacket, with a tuft of hair under his chin
Fat and jovial, wearing a top hat
reading.correct: Lean, in tall boots and a short jacket, with a tuft of hair under his chin
reading.explain: The text describes him as a lean Englishman in tall boots and a short jacket with hair left only under his chin.

reading.ru: — Лучше не ходите, — прибавил он, поднимая шляпу. — Я надел намордник, и лошадь возбуждена.
reading.question: Why did the Englishman advise Vronsky not to go in?
options: Because the horse was agitated with her muzzle on
Because the stable was being cleaned
reading.correct: Because the horse was agitated with her muzzle on
reading.explain: He explained that he had put a muzzle on the horse and that she was agitated.

reading.ru: В бараке стояло пять лошадей по денникам, и Вронский знал, что тут же нынче должен быть приведен и стоит его главный соперник, рыжий пятивершковый гладиатор Мохотина.
reading.question: Whose horse, besides Vronsky's, was stabled in the same barrack?
reading.correct: Mahotin's chestnut horse, Gladiator
reading.explain: The text states that Mahotin's chestnut Gladiator, Vronsky's main rival, was to be stabled there too.

reading.ru: Но Вронский знал, что по законам приличия конской охоты не только нельзя видеть его, но неприлично и расспрашивать про него.
reading.question: What unwritten rule did Vronsky observe regarding Gladiator?
options: It was improper even to ask about a rival's horse
Riders must always inspect rivals' horses
Only trainers could enter the stable
Horses had to be shown to the press
reading.correct: It was improper even to ask about a rival's horse
reading.explain: The etiquette of horse racing meant it was improper not only to see but even to inquire about a rival's horse.

reading.ru: Он знал, что это был гладиатор, но с чувством человека, отворачивающегося от чужого раскрытого письма, он отвернулся и подошел к деннику Фру-Фру.
reading.question: What did Vronsky do upon glimpsing Gladiator?
options: He turned away, as if avoiding someone else's open letter
He stopped to examine the horse closely
He laughed at the horse's appearance
reading.correct: He turned away, as if avoiding someone else's open letter
reading.explain: He turned away with the feeling of someone avoiding a stranger's open letter, and went to Frou-Frou's stall instead.

reading.ru: «Фру-фру нервнее, он сильнее», — сказал Вронский, улыбаясь от похвалы своей езде.
reading.question: How did Vronsky compare Frou-Frou to Gladiator?
options: Frou-Frou is more nervous, Gladiator is stronger
Frou-Frou is stronger, Gladiator is faster
reading.correct: Frou-Frou is more nervous, Gladiator is stronger
reading.explain: Vronsky says Frou-Frou is more nervous while Gladiator is stronger.

reading.ru: Фруфру была среднего роста лошадь и по статям небезукоризненная.
reading.question: How is Frou-Frou described physically at first?
options: A medium-sized horse, not flawless in conformation
reading.correct: A medium-sized horse, not flawless in conformation
reading.explain: The text says Frou-Frou was a medium-sized horse, not irreproachable in her conformation.

reading.ru: Но у ней в высшей степени было качество, заставляющее забывать все недостатки. Это качество была кровь.
reading.question: What quality made people forget Frou-Frou's physical flaws?
reading.correct: Her breeding ("blood")
reading.explain: The text says the quality that made one forget all her defects was her "blood," i.e., her breeding.

reading.ru: Она была одной из тех животных, которые, кажется, не говорят только потому, что механическое устройство их рта не позволяет им этого.
reading.question: What impression did Frou-Frou give of her intelligence?
options: She seemed almost able to speak, prevented only by her mouth's construction
reading.correct: She seemed almost able to speak, prevented only by her mouth's construction
reading.explain: The narrator says she seemed like one of those animals that don't speak only because their mouths mechanically cannot.

reading.ru: Как только Вронский вошел к ней, она глубоко втянула в себя воздух, искашивая свой выпуклый глаз так, что белок налился кровью, с противоположной стороны глядела на вошедших, потряхивая намордником и упруго переступая с ноги на ногу.
reading.question: How did Frou-Frou react when Vronsky entered?
options: She breathed in deeply and rolled her eye until the white filled with blood
She lay down on the straw
reading.correct: She breathed in deeply and rolled her eye until the white filled with blood
reading.explain: The text describes her drawing in a deep breath and rolling her prominent eye until the white filled with blood.

reading.ru: Только когда он подошел к ее голове, она вдруг затихла, и мускулы ее затряслись под тонкую нежную шерстью.
reading.question: When did Frou-Frou finally calm down?
options: Only when Vronsky reached her head
As soon as he entered the stall
After the Englishman spoke to her
reading.correct: Only when Vronsky reached her head
reading.explain: Only when he approached her head did she suddenly quiet down, her muscles trembling under her fine coat.

reading.ru: «Ну так я на вас надеюсь», — сказал он англичанину. «В шесть с половиной на месте».
reading.question: What arrangement did Vronsky confirm with the Englishman?
options: To be at the place at half past six
To meet at the hippodrome at noon
To bring the horse to his house
reading.correct: To be at the place at half past six
reading.explain: Vronsky tells the Englishman he's counting on him to be there at half past six.

reading.ru: «А вы куда едете, милорд?» — спросил он, неожиданно употребив это название «My Lord», которого он почти никогда не употреблял.
reading.question: What surprised Vronsky about the Englishman's question?
options: He unexpectedly addressed him as "My Lord"
He refused to answer any questions
reading.correct: He unexpectedly addressed him as "My Lord"
reading.explain: The Englishman unexpectedly used the term "My Lord," which he almost never used, surprising Vronsky.

reading.ru: «Который раз мне делают нынче этот вопрос?» — сказал он себе и покраснел, что с ним редко бывало.
reading.question: What rare reaction did Vronsky have to being asked where he was going?
options: He blushed, which rarely happened to him
reading.correct: He blushed, which rarely happened to him
reading.explain: The text notes he blushed, something that rarely happened to him.

reading.ru: Едва он отъехал несколько шагов, как туча с утра, угрожавшая дождем, надвинулась и хлынул ливень.
reading.question: What happened just after Vronsky drove off?
options: He met Mahotin on the road
reading.correct: A downpour suddenly broke out
reading.explain: The cloud that had threatened rain since morning closed in, and a downpour broke.

reading.ru: Сидя в уединении закрытой коляски, он достал письмо матери и записку брата и прочел их.
reading.question: What did Vronsky read while riding in his closed carriage?
options: A letter from his mother and a note from his brother
reading.correct: A letter from his mother and a note from his brother
reading.explain: Sitting alone in his closed carriage, he took out his mother's letter and his brother's note and read them.

reading.ru: Все, его мать, его брат, все находили нужно вмешиваться в его сердечные дела».
reading.question: What bothered Vronsky about his mother and brother?
options: They felt it necessary to interfere in his romantic affairs
They refused to speak to him
They wanted him to quit racing
reading.correct: They felt it necessary to interfere in his romantic affairs
reading.explain: He resents that everyone, his mother and brother included, feels the need to meddle in his affairs of the heart.

reading.ru: Эта женщина дороже для меня жизни, и это-то непонятно, и потому досадно им.
reading.question: How does Vronsky feel about Anna, according to his thoughts?
options: She is dearer to him than life
She is less important than his career
She is a burden to him
reading.correct: She is dearer to him than life
reading.explain: Vronsky thinks to himself that this woman is dearer to him than life itself.

reading.ru: Он чувствовал, что любовь, связывавшая его с Анной, не была минутное увлечение, которое пройдет, как проходят светские связи, не оставив других следов в жизни того и другого, кроме приятных или неприятных воспоминаний.
reading.question: How did Vronsky view his love for Anna?
options: As lasting, not a passing infatuation like ordinary society affairs
As identical to his past affairs
reading.correct: As lasting, not a passing infatuation like ordinary society affairs
reading.explain: He felt that the love binding him to Anna was not a momentary infatuation that would pass like ordinary society liaisons.

reading.ru: Он чувствовал всю мучительность своего и ее положения, всю трудность при той выставленности для глаз всего света, в которой они находились, скрывать свою любовь, лгать и обманывать.
reading.question: What did Vronsky feel about their situation?
options: The agonizing difficulty of hiding their love under society's watchful eyes
That society was unaware of their relationship
That lying was easy for him
That Anna's husband already knew everything
reading.correct: The agonizing difficulty of hiding their love under society's watchful eyes
reading.explain: He felt the full torment of their position and the difficulty of hiding, lying, and deceiving while exposed to the whole world's gaze.

reading.ru: И ему в первый раз пришла в голову ясная мысль о том, что необходимо прекратить эту ложь, и чем скорее, тем лучше.
reading.question: What clear thought occurred to Vronsky for the first time?
options: That the lying must end, the sooner the better
That he should retire from the army
That he should marry Kitty instead
reading.correct: That the lying must end, the sooner the better
reading.explain: For the first time, a clear thought came to him that this lying had to end, and the sooner the better.

reading.ru: «Бросить все ей и мне и скрыться куда-нибудь одним с своею любовью», — сказал он себе.
reading.question: What did Vronsky consider doing with Anna?
options: Abandoning everything and hiding away somewhere together with their love
reading.correct: Abandoning everything and hiding away somewhere together with their love
reading.explain: He tells himself that both of them should abandon everything and hide away somewhere alone with their love.
